title: Entitlements a Mountain Dining Plans Plan Carries Alongside Its Balance
content:
A plan in the Mountain Dining Plans range carries table entitlements alongside the balance: the window ahead within which the holder may reserve a table, priority seating where the plan includes it, the chef's table seatings and the hours of private dining room use the plan carries for the season, and a wine locker at a collective outlet where the plan includes one. Those entitlements are drawn on by reserving rather than by spending, so using them moves nothing off the balance and a plan with no balance left keeps them until the season ends.

## The five entitlements

| Entitlement | What the plan carries | How it is drawn on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The reservation window | the window ahead within which the holder may reserve a table | by reserving |
| Priority seating | priority seating at table service outlets, where the plan includes it | by reserving |
| Chef's table seatings | the seatings the plan carries for the season | by reserving |
| Private dining room hours | the hours the plan carries for the season | by reserving |
| A wine locker | a locker at a collective outlet, where the plan includes one | by reserving |

## Points of judgement

**The balance is untouched.** An entitlement is drawn on by reserving and not by spending, so drawing on one moves nothing off the plan's balance.

**A plan standing at nothing.** Because the entitlements answer to the plan and not to the balance, a plan with no balance left keeps them, and keeps them until the season ends.

**Priority seating and the wine locker.** Each of these stands only on a plan that includes it; the entitlement is what the plan carries, and it is the plan that says whether it is carried at all.
